title: Generic Gauntlet
prompt: Implement `sumSquares` (binary fold over squares, empty pack -> 0) and `countPack` (sizeof...).
boilerplate:
#include <cstddef>

template <class... A>
constexpr int sumSquares(A... a);   // empty pack -> 0

template <class... A>
constexpr std::size_t countPack(A... a);   // element count

tests.name: sumSquares folds squares
tests.hint: (0 + ... + (a * a)) — the binary fold handles the empty pack.
